sentences.show: On this day in 1869, two men tried to corner America's gold.
Jay Gould and James Fisk formed the Gold Ring, to force up the price on the New York Gold Exchange.
Their inside man? The President's own brother-in-law.
But President Grant ordered the Treasury to sell gold, and the price plummeted.
Every day has a story like this. History Unlocked — link in bio.
